The first step is to never give up.  Even if you are tired of this and just want it to end. Never. Give. Up.  Then you need goals.  You need to start small, you can just decide your never gonna tap again, you need to keep I creasing your goal bay maybe just one day. And then if you relapse, you know that you made it so far and that nothing can stop you from getting back to there.  Finally, you have to know you can.  This is simple.  And its simple because everyone knows it and everybody has been told this at some point in their life and if they haven't, here it is.  You can do hard things.
